Qualified in NET/GATE or equivalent national eligibility test. Candidate should have sound experience in bioinformatics, cloning, protein expression & purification and standard molecular biology techniques.

how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Guwahati Junior Research Fellow (Direct) Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 25-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Guwahati to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Guwahati JRF (Direct) recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for the JRF (Direct) position at IIT Guwahati is 25th August 2026. Candidates are strongly advised to submit their applications before this deadline to avoid any last-minute technical issues.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the JRF (Direct) post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the JRF (Direct) post will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 37,000 to Rs. 44,400 per month, as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What are the essential qualifications required for the JRF (Direct) position?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BE/B.Tech or ME/M.Tech or MSc degree in life sciences or bio-technology. Additionally, they need research experience in specific fields like Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, Computational Biology, or Structural Biology, along with NET/GATE qualification.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, according to the provided information, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the JRF (Direct) post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the JRF (Direct) position at IIT Guwahati will primarily involve an Online Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the JRF (Direct) post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the JRF (Direct) position in this recruitment drive by IIT Guwahati.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The JRF (Direct) position at IIT Guwahati is a contractual job type.

faq.question: Q8. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be accessed through the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to download and read it thoroughly.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates with a Master's degree apply for this post?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates with an MSc degree in life sciences or bio-technology, along with the specified research experience and NET/GATE qualification, are eligible to apply.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of IIT Guwahati?
faq.answer: IIT Guwahati is located in Guwahati, Assam, with the pincode 781039.
